ruleDefinitions.name: Winget Admin Settings Modification
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects changes to the AppInstaller (winget) admin settings. Such as enabling local manifest installations or disabling installer hash checks

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\winget\\\.exe$") AND registry_path = RGX("^\\\\REGISTRY\\\\A\\\\") AND registry_path = RGX("\\\\LocalState\\\\admin\\_settings$"))
